title: Man who died at airport reportedly given sedation
article: A man who died after being arrested at Ottawa's airport on the weekend had been given a restraint injection by paramedics, radio station CFRA reported Wednesday.
The paramedic administered the sedative at the request of a police officer and after obtaining permission from a doctor because Stephane Michaud, 43, was deemed to be out of control, the report said.
The handcuffed Michaud reportedly lost consciousness within seconds of the injection and never recovered.
The hospital where Michaud was taken confirmed there was a consultation with the paramedic, but wouldn't comment further.
An initial autopsy done Tuesday could not pinpoint the cause of death and it is unclear whether the injection played any role.
The regional coroner said toxicology testing was underway but could take up to three months to get results.
